evidence.title: Recraft | AI for designers, creatives, sellers, and teams

name: Recraft
summary: AI design platform for generating and editing vector art, images, logos and mockups from prompts, with custom styles and palettes.
description: Recraft Studio generates and edits raster and vector images from prompts: photorealism, illustrations, vector art, logos, mockups, seamless patterns and text, with custom styles, color palettes and a vector editor. Recraft's own V2-V4.1 models sit alongside external models (Flux, Ideogram, GPT Image, Veo, Sora). Available as a web studio, iOS and Android apps, a REST API and an MCP server.
contains: models: Recraft V2-V4.1 plus external models (Flux, Ideogram, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Veo, Sora)
vector generation with editable SVG output, logos, icons and typography
custom styles from dropped-in images; color palettes and seamless patterns
mockups, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, background remover
web studio plus iOS and Android apps
REST API, hosted MCP server and plugins
free plan and paid plans; credits reset monthly, top-ups never expire
